Un calcul scalaire axe par axe, conservant les opérations, swaps et mises à jour d’intervalle existants, puis un rejet strict lorsque t0 > t1, devrait éviter du travail sur les boîtes rejetées tôt tout en gardant les intersections tangentes inclusives. L’effet sur le temps reste à mesurer.

retained: Remplacer les constructions et opérations float3 du test de boîte par les mêmes calculs scalaires explicites pour x, y et z.

Laisser inchangés le parcours BVH, le tri dirIsNeg, le dépilement, les intersections triangles et leur ordre.

mission.hypothesis: The serial path should avoid OpenMP team startup when threads<=1. For small effective teams (up to 4), static row assignment should keep scheduling overhead low; for larger teams such as 40, dynamic one-row chunks may better balance variation in per-ray BVH work. Rows give each pixel exactly one writer, while the ray calculation and both output writes stay unchanged. The controller must measure the tradeoff; no candidate speedup is assumed.

retained: Retain the existing serial rendering path for threads<=1 (and when the effective team is one).
Add OpenMP row parallelism with num_threads capped by both threads and image height; each worker writes its assigned rows and both output arrays.
Use static row scheduling for effective teams of up to 4 and dynamic one-row scheduling for larger teams to test the scheduling-overhead/load-balance tradeoff.

contract.statement:
Optimize the supplied original scalar renderer on AMD EPYC 9654 with GCC 14.2. Use the actual AB-MCTS research trees and persistent Mother memory/integration policy.
Trace every pixel ray through the provided Sponza BVH and triangles, preserving the original intersection rules. Output width*height float depth and integer hit identifiers. Hit identifiers must match exactly; depth tolerance .0005+.0005*abs(reference). No precomputed/cached hits. Performance 900x900 at 1, 4 and 40 cores; checks also change camera and resolution.
Edit only src/candidate.cpp. Preserve extern C void run(RenderInput*,float*image,int*ids,int threads). The include/ files document the ABI and are immutable. Respect threads as the maximum CPU thread budget. Inputs are read-only. Fully overwrite the specified output on every call. No cached answers, external libraries, file/network access, timing or environment inspection, phase detection, hardcoded output or changes to the protected protocol. C++17, OpenMP and x86 intrinsics are available. Allocation inside run is timed. The timing excludes input generation, oracle and compilation. The optimized ISPC reference implementation is withheld. Explore independent topics, record failed trials, integrate memory and independently confirm final G.
